content:
Meta's Muse AI agent app has topped the US App Store's free iPhone app chart for the past several weeks. The latest Muse app update adds support for a new platform: iPad.

Muse is Meta's nearly free, proactive agent AI tool, competing with Grok Bot, ChatGPT Dots, and OpenClaw.

The latest app update expands support from iPhone to iPad, while adding more connectors and other features. Here's what's in the update:

  • Grow your small business: Connect with tools you already use, such as Asana, Canva, Dropbox, Figma, QuickBooks, GitHub, Klaviyo, Zoom, and Meta Ads accounts
  • Find new customers: Set business goals for Muse and it will execute them for you—including planning marketing content, creating customer outreach proposals, and building brand-new product pages, with your approval every step of the way
  • More connectors: Link to apps you use regularly, such as Granola, Notion, and others
  • Muse now supports iPad

Below are some screenshots of Muse for iPad from the App Store:

The app originally launched on iPhone in September, with Meta releasing a Mac version a few days later.

Muse for iPhone and iPad is available as a free download from the App Store.
